description: Land Title Settlement Department - Horetuduwa, Panadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530011
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, block numbers, cadastral maps, and ownership details) in various villages, with detailed schedules showing land ownership particulars, extents, encumbrances, and other land-related information. This falls squarely under Land Gazettes as it concerns land registration and title settlement matters.
